Your notes, always at hand

### Display notes from PowerPoint & Keynote

PPTControl reads the notes from your presentation automatically — no copying or extra setup.

Just present and stay focused.

[PPTControl Notes Feature]

Precise presentations with just one tap

### Mouse pointer control

Control the computer's cursor as a laser pointer with your smartphone.

Steer the cursor precisely and accurately. Perfect for professional presentations and training
courses.

[PPTControl Laser Pointer Feature]

Simple controls with intuitive buttons

### Control via volume buttons

Use the volume buttons on your smartphone to control the presentation.

Browse through slides without having to look at the screen. Ideal for a smooth presentation flow.

[PPTControl Volume Buttons Feature]

PPTControl makes it possible: control presentations conveniently with your Apple Watch.

## Frequently asked questions

How do I connect PPTControl to my computer?

PPTControl currently connects through Bluetooth Low Energy, also called BLE.

Bluetooth must be enabled on both devices, and PPTControl Desktop must stay open on the computer
while you use the remote.

My phone cannot find or connect to my computer. What should I do?

Make sure [PPTControl Desktop][16] is installed and open on the computer, and that Bluetooth is
enabled on both devices.

Make sure the phone and computer are not paired through normal Bluetooth settings. If they are,
remove that pairing on both devices, restart both devices, and connect again only through
PPTControl.

On Mac, also make sure the required permissions are granted. On Windows, check whether the Bluetooth
adapter supports Bluetooth Low Energy peripheral/server mode.

Can I view speaker notes in PPTControl?

Yes, with Pro, speaker notes are available for supported PowerPoint and Keynote presentations.

Open the presentation on the computer, connect PPTControl, and tap the notes icon in the mobile app.
Make sure the presentation actually contains notes and that both PPTControl apps are updated.

Which presentation apps does PPTControl support?

PPTControl is focused on **Microsoft PowerPoint**, **Apple Keynote**, and **Google Slides**.

Basic slide controls work best with the supported desktop workflows. Advanced features depend on the
presentation app and platform.

## Frequently asked questions

How do I connect PPTControl to my computer?

PPTControl currently connects through Bluetooth Low Energy, also called BLE.

Bluetooth must be enabled on both devices, and PPTControl Desktop must stay open on the computer
while you use the remote.

My phone cannot find or connect to my computer. What should I do?

Make sure [PPTControl Desktop][16] is installed and open on the computer, and that Bluetooth is
enabled on both devices.

Make sure the phone and computer are not paired through normal Bluetooth settings. If they are,
remove that pairing on both devices, restart both devices, and connect again only through
PPTControl.

On Mac, also make sure the required permissions are granted. On Windows, check whether the Bluetooth
adapter supports Bluetooth Low Energy peripheral/server mode.

Can I view speaker notes in PPTControl?

Yes, with Pro, speaker notes are available for supported PowerPoint and Keynote presentations.

Open the presentation on the computer, connect PPTControl, and tap the notes icon in the mobile app.
Make sure the presentation actually contains notes and that both PPTControl apps are updated.

Which presentation apps does PPTControl support?

PPTControl is focused on **Microsoft PowerPoint**, **Apple Keynote**, and **Google Slides**.

Basic slide controls work best with the supported desktop workflows. Advanced features depend on the
presentation app and platform.

# Pioneers in IoT and M2M since 1999

Founded 1999 in Germany, we are a leading developer of IoT gateways & ODM services
and Telit Cinterion's oldest, most trusted and licensed distributor.

IoT modules by telit CINTERION

## Blink and you'll miss it.

5G RedCap is here — efficient, secure, and built for massive IoT. As Telit Cinterion’s
longest-standing partner, we bring you their latest award-winning 5G modules — designed to deliver
reliable performance, optimized bandwidth, and lower power consumption for your next-generation
products.

[Discover our Modules][10]
[TelitCinterion 5G wireless cellular modules]
[IoT Antenna]
CUSTOM & STANDARD ANTENNAS

## Your Signal. Anywhere.

Our partner Sunnyway Technology build the antennas, RoundSolutions makes them work in your world.
Trusted by automotive, smart metering, and e-mobility leaders — our designs cut through noise,
deliver precision, and scale with your mission. From IoT startups to global OEMs: if it moves,
transmits, or tracks, we keep it connected.

[Discover Our Antennas][11]
assetmonitoring.info

## Industrial IoT Use Cases for Real-World Challenges

Discover how businesses use Industrial IoT to monitor inventory, track assets, reduce downtime and
gain real-time visibility into critical operations. From IBC monitoring and pressure monitoring to
asset tracking and machine monitoring, our use cases show how connected devices and cloud platforms
create measurable business value.

[Discover AssetMonitoring.info][12]
Industrial Single Board Computers

### Performance Without Limits.

Industrial-grade, ARM-based, and built for long-term availability. Gateworks Single Board Computers
provide **high-performance NXP ARM® processing power** designed for rugged industrial embedded
applications, making them a reliable foundation for IoT solutions – from transportation and energy
to smart city deployments.

[Discover our SBCs][13]
Industrial Single Board Computers

### GW16168 Edge AI Accelerator for Gateworks Industrial SBCs

The **GW16168** is an M.2 AI accelerator card designed to add powerful edge AI processing to
Gateworks industrial SBCs. Powered by the **NXP ARA240 Neural Processing Unit**, it delivers up to
**40 eTOPS** of AI performance for real-time workloads such as machine vision, robotics, and
predictive maintenance. With **16GB LPDDR4 memory** and a standard **M.2 PCIe interface**, it
enables efficient deployment of AI models directly on embedded and industrial IoT devices.

[Buy the GW16168 now][14]
Industrial Single Board Computers

### GW16167 802.11ah
### Wi-Fi HaLow M.2 Radio

The GW16167 is an 802.11ah Wi-Fi HaLow M.2 card designed for long-range, reliable IoT connectivity
on Gateworks industrial SBCs. Operating in the 850–950 MHz band, it supports data rates up to 43.3
Mbps and transmit power up to +26 dBm, enabling extended coverage and strong signal penetration
through walls and industrial environments. Powered by the Morse Micro MM8108 chipset, it provides
stable, low-power wireless communication for demanding IoT and embedded applications.

[Buy the GW16167 now][15]
IO-GATE

## Real-Time Industrial IoT Monitoring – from Sensor to Cloud

Track and manage IBC containers and industrial assets worldwide with secure 4G/5G connectivity,
real-time insights, and zero manual intervention — driven by edge intelligence.

## Maximize Business Impact

Discover award-winning **[IoT modules][145]**, [**cellular data plans**][146], **[edge AI][147]**,
**[secure data orchestration][148]** and **[custom solutions][149]** that can help you realize your
business vision. [Connect with us][150] to start and scale your digital transformation and change
how your business harnesses AI.

## IoT Technologies in Focus

[
[A variety of smart home devices are arranged on a table, with digital icons above them representing
connected technology features.]

#### **IoT Hardware Design and Solutions:
#### A Guide**

Designing IoT hardware that holds up in the field starts with the use case and environment, not the
component list.

][151] [
[Person holding a smartphone with a digital hologram displaying an electronic SIM (eSIM) chip and
circuit pattern above the device.]

#### **What Are the Differences between SIM, eSIM and iSIM?**

The SIM market is shifting from removable cards toward chip-level integration, and each form factor
fits different needs.

][152] [
[A microchip labeled "AI" is positioned at the center of a digital circuit pattern shaped like a
human brain, symbolizing artificial intelligence technology.]

#### **deviceWISE^{®} Intelligence Suite:
#### Enabling Active Intelligence **

Active intelligence transforms industrial IoT data into real-time actions that support smarter, more
autonomous operations.

][153]

## Industries in the Spotlight

[
[Young plant growing in soil with digital overlays showing icons for sunlight, water, temperature,
pH, phosphorus, and nitrogen, representing growth conditions.]

#### **Smart Agriculture with IoT:
#### From Concept to Full Deployment**

IoT-enabled smart agriculture integrates connected sensors and real-time analytics to improve
efficiency in modern farming operations.

][154] [
[A digital electricity meter displays a reading, overlaid with transparent circuit patterns
representing smart technology integration.]

#### **Smart Meter Design Considerations**

Smart meter solutions integrate IoT connectivity with innovative design principles to ensure
efficiency and longevity in the field.

][155] [
[A person presses the button on a black wristband featuring a large red emergency alert button.]

#### **Personal Emergency Response Systems:
#### Inside the Devices**

PERS devices integrate IoT connectivity with wearable design to extend emergency monitoring beyond
fixed deployments.

][156]

## Advance Your IoT Project with Our Expertise

[
[An IoT module with the Telit Cinterion logo, surrounded by digital concentric circles and circuitry
lines and dots.]

#### **Modules**

Explore the industry’s broadest portfolio of secure, certified cellular **IoT modules**, which can
be used alone or combined into solutions.

][157] [
[A digital representation of a SIM card and an eSIM with a circuit background.]

#### **Connectivity**

Get your solution to market quickly and reduce the costs of **IoT connectivity** and deployment
management, regardless of scale or stage.

][158] [
[A view of a digital screen with data represented by graphs, surrounded by concentric circles and
circuitry lines and dots.]

#### **Platforms**

Leverage our **IoT platform** to connect systems and launch faster. Integrate AI and machine
learning for visual inspection and object recognition.

][159] [
[A handheld credit card reader with a card inserted, surrounded by concentric circles and circuitry
lines and dots.]

#### **Custom Solutions**

Elevate your business with our custom IoT services and **turnkey solutions** that integrate with
your technology stack. Achieve success with our expertise.

][160]

## ThingsBoard Features

### [Telemetry Data Collection][103]

Collect and store telemetry data in reliable way, surviving network and hardware failures. Access
collected data using customizable web dashboards or server-side APIs.

### [Multi-tenancy][104]

Support multi-tenant installations out-of-the-box. Single tenant may have multiple tenant
administrators and millions of devices and customers.

### [Data Visualization][105]

Provides 30+ configurable widgets out-of-the-box and ability to create your own widgets using
built-in editor. Built-in line-charts, digital and analog gauges, maps and much more.

### [Horizontal scalability][106]

Amount of supported server-side requests and devices increase linearly as new thingsboard servers
are added in clustering mode. No downtime, server restarts or application errors.

### [IoT Rule Engine][107]

Process incoming device data with flexible rule chains based on entity attributes or message
content. Forward data to external systems or trigger alarms using custom logic. Configure complex
notification chains on alarms. Enrich server-side functionality or manipulate your devices with
highly customizable rules. Define your application logic with drag-n-drop rule chain designer.

### [Customization and Integration][108]

Extend default platform functionality using customizable [rule chains][109], [widgets][110] and
[transport implementations][111]. In addition to MQTT, CoAP and HTTP support, ThingsBoard users can
use their own transport implementations or customize behaviour of existing protocols. You can also
take advantage of our [IoT development services][112] to create tailored solutions for your needs.

## Wiliot FAQs

### What does Wiliot do?

Wiliot helps enterprises gain real-time visibility into their supply chain by turning physical
products into digital data sources. Using the Wiliot Physical AI platform, companies can track the
location, movement, and condition of items automatically — without scanning — enabling smarter,
faster, and more efficient operations.

### What is the Wiliot Physical AI platform?

The Wiliot Physical AI platform connects the physical world to AI systems by continuously capturing
data from products and assets. It combines Wiliot’s IoT Pixels, network infrastructure, and
cloud-based AI to create a live, always-on view of supply chain operations — enabling automation,
optimization, and real-time decision-making.

### How is Wiliot different from traditional supply chain technologies like RFID or barcodes?

Traditional technologies rely on manual scans or fixed checkpoints, creating gaps in visibility.
Wiliot provides continuous, ambient data capture without scanning, eliminating blind spots and
reducing infrastructure costs — while delivering real-time, item-level intelligence across the
entire supply chain.

### What is Physical AI and why does it matter?

Physical AI brings real-world operations into AI systems by turning physical items into continuous
data sources. This matters because most supply chains today rely on delayed or incomplete data. With
Physical AI, companies can move from reactive decisions to proactive, automated operations driven by
real-time insights.

### How does Wiliot enable supply chain AI?

Supply Chain AI requires accurate, real-time data to work effectively. Wiliot provides that data
layer by continuously capturing information from physical items. This allows AI systems to detect
issues, predict outcomes, and automate workflows — improving inventory accuracy, reducing waste, and
optimizing logistics performance.

### What business outcomes can companies achieve with Wiliot?

Companies using Wiliot improve inventory accuracy, reduce labor and operational costs, minimize
waste, and increase product availability. By automating data capture and enabling AI-driven
decisions, organizations can unlock significant ROI while building more resilient, efficient supply
chains.

## Wiliot FAQs

### What does Wiliot do?

Wiliot helps enterprises gain real-time visibility into their supply chain by turning physical
products into digital data sources. Using the Wiliot Physical AI platform, companies can track the
location, movement, and condition of items automatically — without scanning — enabling smarter,
faster, and more efficient operations.

### What is the Wiliot Physical AI platform?

The Wiliot Physical AI platform connects the physical world to AI systems by continuously capturing
data from products and assets. It combines Wiliot’s IoT Pixels, network infrastructure, and
cloud-based AI to create a live, always-on view of supply chain operations — enabling automation,
optimization, and real-time decision-making.

### How is Wiliot different from traditional supply chain technologies like RFID or barcodes?

Traditional technologies rely on manual scans or fixed checkpoints, creating gaps in visibility.
Wiliot provides continuous, ambient data capture without scanning, eliminating blind spots and
reducing infrastructure costs — while delivering real-time, item-level intelligence across the
entire supply chain.

### What is Physical AI and why does it matter?

Physical AI brings real-world operations into AI systems by turning physical items into continuous
data sources. This matters because most supply chains today rely on delayed or incomplete data. With
Physical AI, companies can move from reactive decisions to proactive, automated operations driven by
real-time insights.

### How does Wiliot enable supply chain AI?

Supply Chain AI requires accurate, real-time data to work effectively. Wiliot provides that data
layer by continuously capturing information from physical items. This allows AI systems to detect
issues, predict outcomes, and automate workflows — improving inventory accuracy, reducing waste, and
optimizing logistics performance.

### What business outcomes can companies achieve with Wiliot?

Companies using Wiliot improve inventory accuracy, reduce labor and operational costs, minimize
waste, and increase product availability. By automating data capture and enabling AI-driven
decisions, organizations can unlock significant ROI while building more resilient, efficient supply
chains.
